findings.title: Calls a zero-argument isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() that does not exist
findings.body: The new condition `context.getUser() != null && !isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` calls a no-arg method. The only definition added in UsernamePasswordForm.java is `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user)`, which takes the user and is protected. No no-arg overload is added anywhere in the diff, so UsernameForm.java will not compile and the services module build fails. The intended call is most likely `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser())`, which would also make the skip-form decision depend on whether passkeys are enabled for the realm.

findings.title: NoSuchElementException import is left unused after the assertThrows removal
findings.body: The two `Assert.assertThrows(NoSuchElementException.class, ...)` calls were replaced with `MatcherAssert.assertThat(...)`, but the `org.openqa.selenium.NoSuchElementException` import was not removed. In this file it is now unused, which triggers a compiler/checkstyle warning and may fail a strict lint build.

findings.title: util package now statically depends on a constant in the browser authenticator package
findings.body: AuthenticatorUtils (util package) now statically imports USER_SET_BEFORE_USERNAME_PASSWORD_AUTH from AbstractUsernameFormAuthenticator (browser package), while browser classes already import AuthenticatorUtils. This creates a two-way package dependency. The constant would be cleaner in a shared place, or the helper could live with the browser authenticators.
